resources.string: While on, reads aloud whatever you touch or drag your finger over. Turn it on and off with the accessibility shortcut. Normal touch input is paused while it is on.

Turn Speak on Touch on with the accessibility shortcut (accessibility button or volume keys) or from Accessibility settings. While it is on, touch or drag across the screen to hear items. Turn it off the same way.
Focus whole item, like TalkBack (e.g. read an entire chat row instead of just its name)
